title: Cadre agent catalog (roster/catalog.yaml)
description: Standalone, frontmatter-independent shape contract for roster/catalog.yaml, scoped as a lighter external-consumer-facing contract per requirements SV-FR-1..6 / requirements.md Gap G-1: catalog.yaml is generated output from generate_role_metadata.py, which already performs fail-closed per-role enum/tier validation at generation time against AGENT.md frontmatter. This schema re-validates the file's own on-disk shape in isolation, as a project consuming only catalog.yaml (with no access to this repository's AGENT.md sources) would need to. It intentionally does not duplicate generate_role_metadata.py's frontmatter cross-check, does not confirm `definition` resolves to a file on disk (a filesystem check, not expressible in JSON Schema -- see roster/orchestration/src/schema_validate.py's supplementary checks), and does not detect duplicate role ids (YAML mapping keys are already deduplicated by the time a parser hands back an object -- see schema_validate.py's supplementary duplicate-id check operating on the raw text).
